summary: Add the artifact-review resume delivery's durable claim mark (run_claimed_at) and send witness (resume_task_result) to artifact_review_resume_outbox for cinatra#3745. Both columns are nullable and additive (ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS); fresh-install bootstrap and Drizzle twins ship with the module and no row is rewritten. A rollout guard raises, with a count and the agent_run_stop operator road, only when core__0115 was applied in an earlier migration session and an unmarked delivering intent holds a running run. Automatic down refuses because dropping the columns would strand claimed runs.
